title: Detector confidence threshold
criterion_preregistered: Pre-registered rule: "lowest confidence threshold such that at most 5% of development non-TB images have any detection box above it". Operationalisation: computed on the development detections of the D17 checkpoint (EMA weights); non-TB images = development images without annotated lesion boxes; an image 'has a box above t' if its highest box score s satisfies s >= t (the same comparison as n_lesions_above_thr in C10); candidate thresholds are the grid 0.010, 0.011, ..., 1.000; the threshold is the smallest grid value t with (non-TB images having a box with s >= t) / (all development non-TB images) <= 0.05. Reported with it: that share with a 95% Wilson CI and n, and TB image-level lesion sensitivity at t (Wilson CI). Requires the guide's acknowledgement (guide_ack) before locking.
